design.decision: When one partner bids nil, the other bids as high as they dare, because a bigger contract makes the nil bonus bigger; if the contract is set while the nil is made, the bonus still multiplies a negative base.
design.opponent: Visible at bidding: a nil next to a big bid is a signal; opponents push to bust the nil or to set the big contract, and either one hurts.
design.rationale: Ties Nil to bid size, which the pool needs, and turns the nil partner's bid into a real decision instead of a safe minimum. Its trigger differs from uc-nil-contract-mult (made nil rather than bid nil), so the risk is paid off only by success.
design.draftText: +3 contract multiplier for each trick in your team's contract if your team makes a nil

critic.concerns: Differs from uc-nil-contract-mult only in the trigger (made versus bid nil); fine.
